en.eNote: No meals logged for Aug 25 – Aug 31 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~572 kcal/day, up from ~492 on the Aug 29 board, and almost all of that rise is Sunday's hike at 1,236 kcal — the biggest day in the window by 465. Tuesday's deadlift day is 771, Wednesday's swim 709, Thursday's hack squat 622, Saturday's front squat 570, Friday's rest day 93 across 5,807 steps, and today reads 0 — nothing recorded yet this morning.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 655 because the day just started). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −986 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Sunday's hike alone implies ≈ −1,650, Tuesday ≈ −1,185, Wednesday ≈ −1,123, Thursday ≈ −1,036 and Saturday ≈ −984; Friday's rest day implies ≈ −507 and today ≈ −414 on these assumptions.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: Six days on out of seven, and the biggest aerobic day of the block
en.i1: The window now runs Tuesday to Monday and only Friday is empty. Five sessions, 9h 39m, 35,777 kg, 4,495 active kcal — against 6h 04m and 3,592 kcal on the Aug 29 board, and nearly the whole jump is one session. Sunday was Zagreb Hiking: 4h 24m, 11.7 km, avg HR 91, max 144, 1,645 active kcal, 15,765 steps. At 264 minutes it is not far off the 315 minutes of the four gym and pool sessions combined. Its effort score of 83 wants a caveat — the formula is minutes × %HRR, and at an average of 91 bpm you were barely above the 53 resting anchor, so that 83 is volume, not intensity. Thursday's hack squat day is still the biggest piece of lifting: 85 minutes, 19 sets, 201 reps, 15,762 kg. Saturday's front squat day came in at 84 minutes, 21 sets, 220 reps, 9,875 kg, top set 80 kg × 8 at RPE 8. Tuesday's deadlift day holds the highest gym effort at 47 (82 minutes, avg HR 123). Only one swim made the frame this time — Wednesday's 2,200 m as 10×100 + 10×50, max HR 165 and 784 kcal, the highest burn of any non-hike session — because Monday's swim rolled out of the window.
en.i2t: Third board running with no tracked lift; the goblet squat has now passed eighty days
en.i2: The Aug 29 board asked for a goblet squat and you ran a front squat day instead. Saturday's session was Front Squat, Bent Over Row, Chest Press, Seated Leg Curl, Lateral Raise and Bicep Curl — nothing tracked in it — so the per-set HR chart is unchanged for a third refresh and both gaps just got wider. Goblet squat is 81 days from Jun 11 and is the oldest hole on the board. Trap-bar deadlift is 72 days from Jun 20. The last four points on the chart remain all hack squat and all four carry the uncertain flag, so there has been no confident reading since Jun 20 — that is what makes the goblet squat worth more than its tonnage. It is also still the cheapest of the three to run: four working sets at 48 kg, one clean HR block, roughly 20 minutes. On the trap bar, the eight-day window from Tuesday's barbell hinge is nearly clear — Tuesday or Wednesday works.
en.i3t: Data quality: training complete, sleep complete, one chart caveat
en.i3: Hevy and Intervals.icu were both synced at the start of this refresh and nothing is missing on the training side. Hevy holds full set-by-set data with RPE for all three lifting days, so 10,140 kg, 15,762 kg and 9,875 kg are measured rather than estimated — and every one of Saturday's 21 sets carries an RPE, which is exactly what the last board asked for. Friday's rest day is real and not a sync gap: 93 active kcal, 5,807 steps, max HR 98, no activity file. Sunday's hike is Garmin-only, as a hike should be. Today has nothing yet — 0 active kcal and 17 steps at 07:14. Sleep is now complete across the whole displayed window for the first time in over a week: the Aug 23 and Aug 24 calendar gaps have rolled out of the frame, so all seven evening slots from Mon 24 to Sun 30 are recorded. One caveat on this board rather than in the data: the chart axes are fixed (effort 55, duration 95m, kcal 950, distance 2,500m) and Sunday's hike exceeds all four, so its bar is clipped on those views. Read the hike from the tooltip, not the bar height.
en.i4t: Recovery: the best night of the block, and the hike is why
en.i4: Last night scored 94 on 7h 39m — twenty-nine points above the night before and the best night on the board. Zero awakenings, zero minutes awake, 100% sleep efficiency, against six awakenings and 64 minutes awake at 86% the night before. REM hit 2h 05m and 27%, highest of the seven by seventeen minutes; deep held 1h 15m at 16%; together 3h 20m and 44% of the night, ahead of every other night by 33 minutes. HRV 43 is the highest reading of the window, RHR 53 the lowest, overnight stress 12 against 25 and nothing else below 25. Readiness 88. The controlled comparison is the useful part: you went to bed at 22:50 on both Saturday and Sunday evenings, and Saturday scored 65 while Sunday scored 94. Bedtime was not the variable — Sunday's 4h 24m hike at avg HR 91 was. Set that against Friday, a complete rest day that produced a 73. Easy aerobic volume is buying you more sleep quality than resting is.
en.rec: Goblet squat today. Readiness is 88 off the best night of the block, nothing on the recovery side is flagged, and at 81 days it is the oldest gap on the board — this is the morning to spend on it. It is the cheapest of the three tracked lifts to run and it would give the per-set HR chart its first confident point since Jun 20, which matters because the last four points are all estimates. Four working sets at 48 kg, keep the rest intervals even so the HR block reads cleanly, and log every set with RPE the way you logged all 21 on Saturday. Trap bar Tuesday or Wednesday: you hinged with the barbell on Aug 25, so the eight-day window is clear from tomorrow. Get a swim back in midweek too — only one made this window because Monday's rolled out, and two per week has been the steady element of this block. The recovery instruction has changed, so read this part carefully. Bedtime is fixed and working: 22:50 two nights running after four nights that had drifted to 23:46. That is done, keep it. The new finding is that a long easy aerobic day beats a rest day for your sleep — Friday's full rest gave you 73, Sunday's 4h 24m hike at avg HR 91 gave you 94 off the same bedtime. Keep one long Z1–Z2 day in the week rather than one blank one. Next: goblet squat today, trap bar Tuesday or Wednesday, a swim midweek, hold 22:50, and put the long easy day back in next weekend.

hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 25.–31.8. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosječno ~572 kcal/dan, više od ~492 s ploče od 29.8., a gotovo cijeli taj skok je nedjeljno planinarenje sa 1.236 kcal — najveći dan u prozoru za 465. Utorkov dan mrtvog dizanja je 771, srijedino plivanje 709, četvrtkov hack čučanj 622, subotnji prednji čučanj 570, petkov dan odmora 93 uz 5.807 koraka, a danas piše 0 — jutros još ništa nije zabilježeno.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 655 jer je dan tek počeo). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −986 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, a ne mjerena. Samo nedjeljno planinarenje implicira ≈ −1.650, utorak ≈ −1.185, srijeda ≈ −1.123, četvrtak ≈ −1.036 i subota ≈ −984; petkov dan odmora implicira ≈ −507, a danas ≈ −414 uz iste pretpostavke.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Šest dana rada od sedam i najveći aerobni dan u bloku
hr.i1: Prozor sada ide od utorka do ponedjeljka i prazan je samo petak. Pet treninga, 9h 39m, 35.777 kg, 4.495 aktivnih kcal — naspram 6h 04m i 3.592 kcal s ploče od 29.8., a gotovo cijeli skok je jedan trening. Nedjelja je bila Zagreb Hiking: 4h 24m, 11,7 km, prosječni puls 91, maksimalni 144, 1.645 aktivnih kcal, 15.765 koraka. Sa 264 minute nije daleko od 315 minuta četiriju treninga u teretani i bazenu zajedno. Njegov napor od 83 traži ogradu — formula je minute × %HRR, a uz prosjek od 91 otkucaj jedva si bio iznad sidra mirovanja od 53, pa je tih 83 volumen, a ne intenzitet. Četvrtkov dan hack čučnja i dalje je najveći komad dizanja: 85 minuta, 19 serija, 201 ponavljanje, 15.762 kg. Subotnji dan prednjeg čučnja bio je 84 minute, 21 serija, 220 ponavljanja, 9.875 kg, najteža serija 80 kg × 8 uz RPE 8. Utorkov dan mrtvog dizanja drži najviši napor u teretani, 47 (82 minute, prosječni puls 123). Ovaj put je u okvir ušlo samo jedno plivanje — srijedinih 2.200 m kao 10×100 + 10×50, maksimalni puls 165 i 784 kcal, najveća potrošnja bilo kojeg treninga osim planinarenja — jer je ponedjeljkovo plivanje ispalo iz prozora.
hr.i2t: Treća ploča zaredom bez praćenog pokreta; goblet čučanj prešao je osamdeset dana
hr.i2: Ploča od 29.8. tražila je goblet čučanj, a ti si odradio dan prednjeg čučnja. Subotnji trening bio je prednji čučanj, veslanje u pretklonu, potisak na spravi, pregib potkoljenica sjedeći, bočno podizanje i pregib za biceps — ništa praćeno — pa je graf pulsa po serijama nepromijenjen treće osvježavanje zaredom, a obje su pauze samo narasle. Goblet čučanj je na 81 dan od 11.6. i najstarija je rupa na ploči. Mrtvo dizanje s trap barom je na 72 dana od 20.6. Zadnje četiri točke na grafu i dalje su sve hack čučanj i sve četiri nose oznaku nesigurnosti, pa pouzdanog očitanja nema od 20.6. — i upravo zato goblet čučanj vrijedi više od svoje tonaže. Ujedno je i dalje najjeftiniji od tri za izvesti: četiri radne serije na 48 kg, jedan čist blok pulsa, otprilike 20 minuta. Što se trap bara tiče, osmodnevni prozor od utorkovog pregiba sa šipkom gotovo je čist — utorak ili srijeda odgovaraju.
hr.i3t: Kvaliteta podataka: trening potpun, san potpun, jedna ograda na grafu
hr.i3: Hevy i Intervals.icu sinkronizirani su na početku ovog osvježavanja i na strani treninga ništa ne nedostaje. Hevy ima potpune podatke po serijama s RPE-om za sva tri dana dizanja, pa su 10.140 kg, 15.762 kg i 9.875 kg izmjereni, a ne procijenjeni — i svaka od subotnjih 21 serija nosi RPE, što je točno ono što je tražila prošla ploča. Petkov dan odmora je stvaran, a ne rupa u sinkronizaciji: 93 aktivne kcal, 5.807 koraka, maksimalni puls 98, bez datoteke aktivnosti. Nedjeljno planinarenje je samo iz Garmina, kako i treba biti. Danas još nema ničega — 0 aktivnih kcal i 17 koraka u 07:14. San je sada potpun kroz cijeli prikazani prozor prvi put u više od tjedan dana: praznine 23.8. i 24.8. ispale su iz okvira, pa je svih sedam večernjih mjesta od pon 24. do ned 30. zabilježeno. Jedna ograda vrijedi za ploču, a ne za podatke: osi grafa su fiksne (napor 55, trajanje 95m, kcal 950, udaljenost 2.500m), a nedjeljno planinarenje prelazi sve četiri, pa mu je stupac odsječen na tim prikazima. Planinarenje čitaj iz opisa, a ne iz visine stupca.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: najbolja noć u bloku, i planinarenje je razlog
hr.i4: Sinoć je ocjena bila 94 uz 7h 39m — dvadeset i devet bodova iznad prethodne noći i najbolja noć na ploči. Nula buđenja, nula minuta budnosti, 100% učinkovitost sna, naspram šest buđenja i 64 minute budnosti uz 86% prethodne noći. REM je dosegao 2h 05m i 27%, najviše od sedam za sedamnaest minuta; duboki san zadržao je 1h 15m i 16%; zajedno 3h 20m i 44% noći, ispred svake druge noći za 33 minute. HRV 43 je najviše očitanje u prozoru, RHR 53 najniže, noćni stres 12 naspram 25, a ništa drugo nije ispod 25. Spremnost 88. Korisni dio je kontrolirana usporedba: u krevet si otišao u 22:50 i u subotu i u nedjelju navečer, a subota je dala 65 dok je nedjelja dala 94. Lijeganje nije bilo varijabla — nedjeljno planinarenje od 4h 24m uz prosječni puls 91 jest. Usporedi to s petkom, potpunim danom odmora koji je dao 73. Lagani aerobni volumen kupuje ti više kvalitete sna nego odmor.
hr.rec: Danas goblet čučanj. Spremnost je 88 nakon najbolje noći u bloku, na strani oporavka ništa nije označeno, a sa 81 danom to je najstarija pauza na ploči — ovo je jutro za nju. Najjeftiniji je od tri praćena pokreta i dao bi grafu pulsa po serijama prvu sigurnu točku od 20.6., što je važno jer su zadnje četiri točke sve procjene. Četiri radne serije na 48 kg, drži pauze ujednačene da se blok pulsa čisto očita i bilježi svaku seriju s RPE-om kako si u subotu zabilježio svih 21. Trap bar u utorak ili srijedu: pregib si sa šipkom radio 25.8., pa je osmodnevni prozor čist od sutra. Vrati i plivanje sredinom tjedna — u ovaj prozor ušlo je samo jedno jer je ponedjeljkovo ispalo, a dva tjedno bila su stabilan element ovog bloka. Uputa za oporavak se promijenila, pa ovaj dio pročitaj pažljivo. Lijeganje je fiksirano i radi: 22:50 dvije noći zaredom nakon četiri noći koje su odlutale na 23:46. To je riješeno, zadrži ga. Novi nalaz je da dug lagani aerobni dan tvom snu donosi više od dana odmora — petkov potpuni odmor dao je 73, nedjeljno planinarenje od 4h 24m uz prosječni puls 91 dalo je 94 uz isto vrijeme lijeganja. Drži jedan dug Z1–Z2 dan u tjednu umjesto jednog praznog. Sljedeće: danas goblet čučanj, trap bar u utorak ili srijedu, plivanje sredinom tjedna, drži 22:50 i vrati dugi lagani dan idući vikend.
